entries.label: Melodia Crystal Cathedral V3: vault + rose + collision + corridor LOD fog
entries.notes: V3 converges V1's Gate 2 verified cathedral with V2's authored corridor by IMPORTING both builders: v2.build_cathedral is call-for-call identical to V1 (golden-asserted), corridor VEX + controls table come verbatim from V2, cathedral controls/helpers from V1. 4 outputs: OUT_Cathedral (0), OUT_Rose (1), OUT_Collision (2), OUT_Corridor (3, fog volume rastering the lowest LOD tier). Corridor fixes: sibling LOD tiers at 40/25/15% keep (a 5% bottom tier rounds to ZERO prims on the 36-prim default mesh), volume.type left at Float, empty group on thicken/bevel, OUT_Corridor outputidx 3, all parm sets via _set. chain_type + lod_count are inner BUILD-time config (baked by the builder), so 18 of 20 controls are promoted. Built via Saved/HDA_build/ + byte copy so rebuilds cannot drop network-bearing files into hda/backup/ (Gate 0 zone). Corridor bay placement along +Z is an art pass, not builder work.

expect.golden_source: Cathedral pins = melodia_crystal_cathedral's measured green cook (shared code path: v3 imports V2's build_cathedral, which is call-for-call identical to V1, and asserts all three counts in --verify).
